verdict.rationale: Supabase documents and hands-on probes confirm an official, live remote MCP server (mcp.supabase.com) with OAuth-gated access, granular scopes, a documented tool catalog organized into feature groups, and local CLI-hosted MCP support, plus a bundled plugin/skills install path for AI coding agents. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of MCP reliability beyond Supabase's own security notes and one community security concern about elevated service_role access.
